text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "We have arrived! At the hot spring inn!!"

On this day, I came to an inn with 
Kawakami Princess to use the 'Hot Springs 
Ticket' she had won in the shopping 
district.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Unlimited access to all hot spring 
facilities! And all-you-can-eat gourmet 
food, too!"
choice_data_list: Looks like I can take it easy for a day.
Looks like we can take it easy for a day.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let us soak all our stress away and 
enjoy the hot springs to the fullest♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And once you are out of the bath, please 
gather in the Trainer's room!

If I recall correctly, meals were supposed 
to be served in a dedicated hall rather 
than in our rooms, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, you're so dense.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't really say things like this 
out loud, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I shall go and confiscate some pillows 
from my room for our pillow fight 
deathmatch♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let's have lots of matches☆ I'm simply 
raring to go~!!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That felt wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It seems like... we'll be able to have... 
lots of... pillow fights... before 
dinner...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-No. Not until I've... thoroughly enjoyed 
the inn with Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list:
Getting plenty of sleep is important so 
you can enjoy everything to the fullest

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "...Y-Yeshh... Understood-waa..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...? Oh, Trainer? Where could you be...?

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text: Princess, are you finally awake-fai?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah~~!? T-The squirrel is talking~~!?

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
"P-Princess! Calm down and listen to Phi! 
I saw the flower of fighting spirit in 
your heart—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Huh.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You... could you be from PreFigh...?

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
That's right-fy! I'm the emissary of the 
turf of light! The fairy who will guide 
you to become a Pre-fy-fy!!

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Looks like nobody's around 
here, fai.

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Princess! Please try on this glass 
slipper, fai!"

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
You're the perfect Umamusume to become the 
next generation's PreFighter! Your destiny 
starts right here-fight!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My... destiny?

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Your fated one— your prince is 
waiting for you, fight!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...My prince.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Fairy. I will not put on those 
glass slippers.

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
Wha, why!? You're supposed to have been 
longing for it, Fi! For something called 
destiny...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, my destiny is something I choose 
myself. It is something I will keep 
walking toward on my own two legs.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And above all else, the prince was—

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? Is it shaking!? M-My dream world 
is...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...It really was a dream after all, 
wasn't it? I must wake up soon."

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me, Fi! I definitely heard the 
footsteps of your wish!

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
This dream is the final line connecting 
us! If it's severed, you won't be able to 
become PreFie anymore-fie!

text_block_list.name: Fairy
text_block_list.text:
The prince who will guide you is... No, 
the legendary Trainer is...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, the shoes I must wear, and the hand I 
must take have already been decided.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am a princess. A princess 
pursuing my own ideals, and no one 
else's!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Mnya mnya... Goodbye, fairy...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning, Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: *yawn*... Is it dinner time yet...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I suppose that is true...
choice_data_list: You could've slept in a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...I am quite fine. I wanted to wake up 
as well."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …………Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
These three years flew by in an instant, 
didn't they? Together, we've walked so 
many different paths.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That path was by no means smooth. It was 
bumpy, and maybe even had a few thorns 
along the way.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yet you never let go of my hand. You 
guided me. And together, we—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...We chose each other.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Will you continue to hold 
my hand and run through this world 
together with me?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I look forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then let us begin our pillow fight right 
away! My energy is fully restored!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Because I took time off specifically to 
spend time with you."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I won't pull any punches, even against 
you, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (...Yes, this is what I have chosen.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Even if a strange man suddenly 
appeared... a different prince claiming to 
be a legendary trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Even if a strange woman suddenly 
appeared... a different prince claiming to 
be a legendary trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (I want you—to be my prince.)

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Kawakami 
Princess...
